new peoject  Athletix: Advanced AI-Driven Performance Engineering Platform
Status Security AI-Core Tech Stack

Athletix is an enterprise-grade performance management ecosystem designed for elite strength coaches and high-performance athletes. It bridges the gap between raw data collection and actionable physiological intelligence using a Hybrid AI Architecture.

🏗️ System Architecture
Athletix utilizes a decoupled, event-driven architecture centered around a sovereign data model. The system is designed for high availability, strict data isolation, and real-time synchronization.

🔄 Data Flow Diagram

🧠 Hybrid Dual-Model AI Engine
Athletix pioneers a Multi-LLM Architecture, leveraging the unique strengths of both Google Gemini and Mistral to deliver real-time, high-fidelity coaching.

The "Bicameral" AI Approach
We split cognitive load between two specialized models to optimize for cost, latency, and reasoning depth:

Feature	Model Used	Why?
Plan Generation	Gemini Ultra/Pro	Requires massive context windows and complex reasoning to understand 12-week periodization cycles, "Cluster Sets", and non-linear progressions.
Real-Time Recovery	Mistral Large	Optimized for speed and acute physiological analysis. It rapidly parses daily logs to give instant "Red/Yellow/Green" readiness scores.
Coach Analytics	Gemini	Synthesizes hundreds of data points across all athletes to answer: "Who is at risk of injury this week?"
Session Chat	Mistral	Low-latency chat interface for athletes to ask: "What should I swap Back Squats with?" while at the gym.
🔄 For the Coach: "The Architect"
Macro-Analysis: The AI scans the entire team's volume load. If 3 athletes report "Knee Pain" on the same "Plyometrics Day", Gemini flags the program design itself as the root cause.
Auto-Regulation: It suggests weight adjustments for the whole roster based on collective RPE trends, saving the coach hours of spreadsheet work.
⚡ For the Athlete: "The Co-Pilot"
Pre-Workout: Mistral analyzes sleep and previous strain to suggest a specific Warm-up Protocol (e.g., "Extra T-Spine mobility needed today").
Post-Workout: Gemini calculates the exact Internal Load and prescribes a recovery window (e.g., "High CNS fatigue detected. 72h recovery recommended for legs").
🛡️ Enterprise Security Model
Security is not an add-on; it is the foundation of the schema.

🔒 Row Level Security (RLS) Policies
Data isolation is enforced at the database kernel level, not just the application layer.

-- Example Policy: Isolation verification
CREATE POLICY "Athletes can only view their own plans"
ON public.athlete_plan_items
FOR SELECT
USING (auth.uid() = athlete_id);
🔐 Double-Blind Authentication
Transport Layer: Standard Bearer Auth via supabase-js.
Application Layer: Custom Middleware validates JWT signature and expiration before any DB connection is spawned.
Data Layer: Each request creates a scoped Postgres transaction tied strictly to the user's UUID.
� Key Technical Featuresno
For AI Engineers
Structured Output: All exercise logs are normalized to standard units (kg/lbs) before ingestion.
Vector Potential: Schema includes text columns for "Coach Notes" ready for future vector embedding and semantic search.
Scalable Migrations: Database schema is managed via SQL migrations, allowing for version-controlled evolution of the data model.
For Performance Coaches
Dynamic Periodization: Support for complex block schemes (Hypertrophy -> Strength -> Peaking).
Smart Copy Engine: Proprietary "Master Template" system allows instant cloning of 12-week macrocycles to unlimited athletes, with automatic date progression logic.
Granular Load Tracking: Captures 8/s (reps per side), Time-Under-Tension, and RPE per set.
�️ Database Schema Overview
The relational model is highly normalized to prevent data redundancy and ensure referential integrity.

Table	Purpose	Key Relationships
athletes	Identity storage and profile data	auth.users (1:1), coaches (N:1)
program_plan_items	Master Templates (The "Class")	Self-referencing block structure
athlete_plan_items	Live Plans (The "Instance")	athletes (N:1)
sessions	Workout containers meta-data	athletes (N:1)
exercise_logs	Micro-data (Sets/Reps/Load)	sessions (N:1)
� Tech Stack
Frontend: React 18, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Framer Motion (for "Glassmorphism" UI).
Backend: Node.js, Express, TypeScript.
Database: PostgreSQL 15 via Supabase.
AI: Google Gemini Pro via Server-Side API integration.
Deployment: Vercel (Frontend), Railway/Render (Backend).
